exposure: Pregnant women aged 35 years or older and pregnant women younger than 35 years of age
cohort: 15,641 pregnant women in Yunnan, China, who underwent routine antenatal screening for HBsAg between 2013 and 2016
finding: The prevalence of HBV infection among pregnant women in Yunnan, China was 7.89%, with advanced age, Hani ethnicity, unemployment, multigravida and multiparous status being associated with increased prevalence.
mod_finding: Hepatitis B virus infection in pregnant women was associated with cesarean section.
